Mr. Esquibel moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $100,000.00, seconded by Mr. Roybal.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Brenda Moureaux, Deputy City Treasurer, provided a staff report and Betsey hale, Cheyenne
LEADS CEO, provided additional information including the City’s return on investment.

       I)     Professional Services Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and I-IDR
              Engineering, Inc., for the 18th Street Reconstruction Project. (2023-2026 Optional
              10/o Sales Tax Fund. FEMA IIMGP Grant and BOPU Funds)


Mr. Roybal moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $1,100,562.00, seconded by Mr. Moody.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Wes Bay, City Drainage Engineer, provided a staff report and Todd Mattson, HDR Engineering,
Inc., was available for questions. Chairman Laybourn and committee members Esquibel and
Roybal commented on the item.

      j)      Right-of-Way License Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Volunteers
              of America Northern Rockies for connection of a storm sewer pipe from the onsite
              detention pond to the storm sewer network in Seymour Avenue near East 25th
              Street.

Mr. Moody moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion carried by unanimous voice
vote.

Erin Gates, Staff Engineer, provided a staff report and committee member Roybal commented on
the item.

       k)     Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Cheyenne and Cheyenne
              Frontier Days, Inc. for the use of city-owned land and buildings for parking,
              camping and other activities during the 2025 Cheyenne Frontier Days Celebration.
              (Revenue to the City)

Mr. Roybal moved to approve, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion carried by unanimous voice
vote.

Jason Sanchez, Community Recreation & Events Director, provided a staff report and Tom Ihirsig,
Cheyenne Frontier Days CEO, was available for questions.

       I)     Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and Laramie County for Animal Control
              Services. (Revenue to the City)

Mr. Roybal moved to approve in an amount of S 156.850.00, seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion
failed with Mr. Esquibel and Mr. Moody voting “NO” and Mr. Roybal voting “YES.”
